layout.guidance: Frame one human outcome with specific evidence and a ranked action while leaving enough warm open space for the hierarchy to breathe.

mobile.guidance: Stack outcome, proof, and action in source order with a labelled compact navigation trigger.

tablet.guidance: Collapse secondary navigation and place the evidence pane below the focal statement when needed.

desktop.guidance: Use the twelve column field for one asymmetrical focal statement, specific proof, and a clear next action.

zoom.guidance: Let navigation, captions, metrics, tables, and actions wrap or reflow without clipping.

reflow.guidance: Preserve complete source ordered fields and use labelled overflow only for irreducible data comparison.

compact.usage: Data cells, tags, and compact indicators.

control.usage: Buttons, fields, menus, and ordinary interactions.

panel.usage: Cards, dialogs, and bounded working surfaces.

media.usage: Large supplied images and atmospheric media frames.

frame.usage: Radiant windows, tables, and structural fields.

control.usage: Buttons, fields, menus, cards, and ordinary interactive boundaries.

focus.usage: Focus, active selection, and consequential separation.

overlay.usage: Dialogs and temporary content above the framed field.

buttons.guidance: Use one filled burnt orange action per focal field and keep secondary actions defined, direct, and stable.

states.default: Use the burnt orange primary with a result focused label.
states.hover: Deepen the primary without changing size or position.
states.focus: Show the semantic focus ring outside the control boundary.
states.active: Compress by at most one pixel without shifting nearby content.
states.disabled: Keep the action readable and expose the unmet prerequisite.
states.loading: Retain the action label beside a visible progress indicator.
states.success: Name the completed outcome with text and the success role.
states.error: Name the failed operation and its recovery with destructive semantics.

links.guidance: Use specific destinations, persistent prose underlines, and an explicit current navigation state.

states.default: Underline prose destinations and use the accessible primary role.
states.hover: Strengthen the underline without changing line height.
states.focus: Frame the link with the same semantic focus ring as controls.
states.active: Preserve the destination while showing immediate activation.
states.disabled: Render unavailable destinations as explained text rather than links.
states.loading: Keep the destination label and add adjacent busy status.
states.success: Confirm the local navigation result in nearby text.
states.error: Explain the local failure and recovery without relying on color.

forms.guidance: Group fields by a human decision, keep help persistent, and place validation in the same reading path.
forms.help: Use the current household estimate supplied by the product.
forms.error: Enter a complete value before reviewing the plan.
forms.success: The profile is complete and ready for review.

inputs.textareaPlaceholder: Add details that affect the plan
inputs.guidance: Keep warm card fields visibly labelled, preserve help, and attach correction text without moving adjacent content.

cards.title: A clearer energy plan
cards.description: One bounded field pairs a useful outcome with the evidence needed to understand it.
cards.guidance: Use a card for one story, proof set, or task, and keep its caption attached to the content it qualifies.

panels.title: What shapes this plan
panels.description: The evidence pane explains the supplied inputs behind the current result.
panels.guidance: Pair one focal pane with one evidence pane and remove divisions that do not clarify the relationship.

navigation.label: Lumenfield product navigation
navigation.guidance: Show the current destination with text and a warm rule, then replace the full list with a labelled mobile trigger when space is limited.

dataDisplay.guidance: Keep the object, status, date, and action aligned with explicit captions, semantic row headings, and tabular values.
dataDisplay.overflowGuidance: Reflow into labelled records first, or use a keyboard reachable scroll region that keeps row identity visible.

badges.label: Current
badges.meaning: The step or view in progress

alerts.title: Plan ready to review
alerts.description: The estimate and supplied assumptions are available.

alerts.title: Usage needs attention
alerts.description: Review the missing period before continuing.

states.loading: Refreshing service states without hiding the last verified state.
states.empty: No services are connected to this operations view yet.
states.filteredEmpty: No services match the active state and owner filters.
states.error: Activity history could not refresh. The last verified state remains available.
states.success: The response route is verified and active.
states.disabled: Escalation remains unavailable until an active response team is assigned.
states.destructive: Removing this service also removes its unresolved local activity history.

feedback.guidance: Attach feedback to the affected outcome, preserve useful information during refresh, and keep the next valid action visible.
feedback.nonColorGuidance: Pair every tone with a written state, meaningful icon, or structural relationship so color is never the only cue.

dialogs.title: Confirm service date
dialogs.description: Review the supplied appointment details before confirming.
dialogs.guidance: Name the purpose, keep the consequence visible, trap focus only while modal, and preserve safe cancellation.
dialogs.escapeBehavior: Escape closes without saving and leaves the current date unchanged.
dialogs.focusRestoration: Return focus to the button that opened the date dialog.

destructiveActions.consequence: The saved profile and its current plan will be removed.
destructiveActions.recoverability: Removal cannot be undone unless the product explicitly provides recovery.
destructiveActions.guidance: Repeat the named object, scope, consequence, and true recovery status before enabling confirmation.

motion.guidance: Reveal focal and evidence panes only after navigation or direct action, keep controls stable, and avoid ambient motion.

reducedMotion.guidance: Remove translation, scaling, smooth scrolling, and sequential pane reveals while preserving labels, focus, and the same information.

accessibility.semantics: Use native landmarks, headings, lists, controls, forms, dialogs, tables, and status regions before ARIA.
accessibility.keyboard: Keep navigation, menus, forms, selection, sorting, overflow, row actions, and dialogs operable in logical source order.
accessibility.focus: Use a persistent two pixel semantic ring with adequate offset on every interactive element.
accessibility.contrast: Measure text, controls, boundaries, status, meaningful graphics, and focus in light and dark schemes.
accessibility.targetSize: Provide at least 24 by 24 CSS pixels with adequate spacing and prefer 44 by 44 for important touch actions.
accessibility.zoom: Support 200 percent page zoom and 400 percent browser zoom without loss of content or operation.
accessibility.reflow: Reflow at 320 CSS pixels without two dimensional page scrolling, clipping, or hidden priority information.
accessibility.forcedColors: Preserve control boundaries, current state, status, and focus with system colors and explicit text.
accessibility.statusCommunication: Name every state in text and announce asynchronous outcomes deliberately without stealing focus.

productSurfaces.guidance: These specimens demonstrate Lumenfield structure only. Replace illustrative words with supplied Project language and preserve every real workflow rule.
